name: Aiura Midori
source:
A newcomer in the Sales Department at Glaðsheimr Japan. He was a member of the rowing club at the same university as Kuze, and joined Glaðsheimr because of his admiration for Kuze. He is a good worker and has a friendly personality, which makes him an idol and a mascot in the Sales Department. In fact, he is very popular with the opposite sex, but he doesn't realize it.

[Translated from the [url=http://pro-page.jp/fpp/uuudiary-disk/character.html]Official Website[/url]]
